tropical_outlook: NHC Atlantic Tropical Weather Outlook issued early Tue Oct 27, 2026: no tropical cyclones in the Atlantic, Caribbean or Gulf, and tropical cyclone formation is not expected during the next 7 days. No threat to Tampa, Jacksonville, Miami or the Gulf/East coast for Week 8. Only active system is Tropical Storm Vance in the Eastern Pacific off the Mexican coast (no US football impact). Source: https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/MIATWOAT.shtml

2026_08_CAR_GB.conditions: Clear and cool; mid-50s at kickoff falling into the 40s by the end of the game; gusty NW winds during the day settle down through the evening
2026_08_CAR_GB.notes: WBAY (Oct 27) and NBC26 (Oct 27) agree: clear Thursday evening, kickoff ~55-56F dropping into the 40s. Wind is the one disagreement: WBAY says gusty NW winds Thursday ease through the evening; a betting preview had W 8-14 mph with gusts, Predictem had near calm. Best estimate 5-10 mph sustained at kickoff, lighter late. Field may be damp from morning showers. Not a true cold game but a cold second half.

2026_08_BAL_BUF.conditions: Mostly cloudy and unseasonably mild, high near 65; shower chance, mainly later in the day; light SW wind
2026_08_BAL_BUF.notes: Country Herald (citing NWS Buffalo, Oct 26): mostly cloudy, high near 65. NWS point forecast for Orchard Park shows Sunday high near 65 with SW wind ~6 mph. Rain chance is the uncertainty: Weather Network 70% (about 5 mm, mostly evening), Weather Underground ~0.01 in, WGRZ 10%. Blended 30% for the 1pm window. No lake-effect or wind concern this week; well above normal for Nov 1.

2026_08_TEN_CIN.conditions: Mild (~70F) with scattered showers likely during the early-to-mid afternoon game window
2026_08_TEN_CIN.notes: NWS Cincinnati point forecast (updated Mon Oct 26): rain likely Sunday, 60% chance, high near 71. WCPO (Oct 26-27): spotty showers Sunday morning, scattered showers early-to-mid afternoon, highs around 70. Wind not emphasized by any source; assume light. Wet-field/rain game risk is the main factor.

2026_08_ARI_DAL.conditions: Indoors expected; outside: humid, cloudy, ~75-80F with rain tapering off from a wet Halloween weekend, 20-30% shower chance remaining
2026_08_ARI_DAL.notes: NWS Fort Worth: Fri Oct 30 rain 40-60%, Sat Oct 31 showers/storms 30-50% with highs upper 70s to mid 80s, rain tapers off into Sunday Nov 1. NBC DFW undated: Sunday 20% showers/storms, high 82. CPC flagged moderate heavy-precip risk for parts of Texas Oct 30-Nov 1. Cowboys keep the roof closed for the vast majority of games and with lingering rain/humidity a closed roof is expected; no official roof announcement found. temp/wind/precip above reflect indoor conditions.

2026_08_MIN_DET.conditions: Indoors, fixed dome - weather not a factor

2026_08_IND_JAX.conditions: Warm and humid, partly sunny, high near 80 with a 30% chance of showers and thunderstorms
2026_08_IND_JAX.notes: NWS Jacksonville point forecast: Sunday partly sunny, high near 80, 30% chance of showers/thunderstorms. NFLWeather.com: ~77F, 36% chance of rain showers, wind ~12 mph W. Warm for November; no tropical threat (NHC quiet). Kickoff temp estimated 77-79F.

2026_08_LV_NYJ.conditions: Mostly cloudy and mild, high near 68; sprinkles possible, shower chance rises to 40% Sunday night after the game
2026_08_LV_NYJ.notes: NWS Upton point forecast (updated Oct 27): Sunday mostly cloudy, high near 68; Sunday night 40% showers, low ~55. timeanddate: 67/54 sprinkles, overcast, ~0.11 in. AccuWeather: 66/50 cloudy, 2% precip. No wind concern noted by any source.

2026_08_CLE_PIT.conditions: Mostly cloudy and mild, high near 67-69 with a 40-75% chance of showers during the afternoon
2026_08_CLE_PIT.notes: NWS Pittsburgh point forecast (updated Oct 25): chance of showers, mostly cloudy, high near 69, 40%. AccuWeather: 67/54, 75% rain, ~5.5 hours of rain. timeanddate: rain, overcast, 67/51, ~0.42 in. Blended 50% for the game window; rain-game risk is real. Wind light.

2026_08_ATL_TB.conditions: Hot and humid, mostly sunny, high near 85 with a 20% chance of isolated afternoon showers/storms
2026_08_ATL_TB.notes: Country Herald citing NWS Tampa Bay (Oct 26): sunshine, high near 85, 20% isolated showers/thunderstorms. AccuWeather: 85/69, 55% (thunderstorm in spots). timeanddate: 85/70, 5%. No tropical threat - NHC says no formation expected in the next 7 days. Heat/humidity is the main factor.

2026_08_LAC_LA.conditions: Indoors (fixed translucent roof) - weather not a factor

2026_08_KC_DEN.venue: Empower Field at Mile High, Denver CO
2026_08_KC_DEN.conditions: Increasing clouds, mild, high in the low 60s; most likely dry during the game, but a storm arriving Sunday night/Monday could bring Front Range snow after the game
2026_08_KC_DEN.notes: Denver7 (Oct 27): increasing clouds on the plains, highs in the low 60s for Sunday's Broncos game; next storm brings mountain snow starting Sunday and the snow level could drop along the Front Range. 9NEWS (Oct 27): game most likely dry, but forecast more uncertain by Sunday as the system could move in Sunday or Monday. 9NEWS 10-day: Sun Nov 1 high 62 / low 43, 20% precip. Late-afternoon kickoff means temps falling through the 50s by the 4th quarter; no snow expected during play but timing is the key uncertainty. Wind not flagged.

2026_08_NE_MIA.venue: Hard Rock Stadium, Miami Gardens FL
2026_08_NE_MIA.conditions: Hot and humid with showers/thunderstorms likely (mainly before noon, then again after 3pm); breezy NE wind 9-17 mph with gusts to ~31 mph
2026_08_NE_MIA.notes: NWS Miami point forecast for Miami Gardens: showers/storms likely mainly before noon, then showers likely and possible thunderstorm after 3pm (overlaps 4:25pm kickoff), high near 83, 60% precip, NE wind 9-17 mph gusting to 31 mph. AccuWeather: 85/72, 67% (afternoon thunderstorms). Weather Network: ~86F, 80%, ~10 mm. Gusty onshore wind plus afternoon storms is the most weather-affected game of the slate alongside Cincinnati/Pittsburgh. No tropical system involved.

2026_08_PHI_WAS.conditions: Mostly cloudy, mild evening in the upper 50s falling to the low 50s; small chance of a light shower; light S/SW breeze
2026_08_PHI_WAS.notes: Daytime high 66-71 per Weather Underground / AccuWeather / Meteored; lows 51-55. DCNewsNow: dry pattern holds through Halloween, 'some rain drops possible' Sunday Nov 1. AccuWeather 19% precip (one snapshot 60%); timeanddate the only source with light rain (~0.15 in). Meteored: S wind 7-19 mph. Night kickoff estimate 57-60F. Capital Weather Gang / NWS Sterling pages not returned in search.

2026_08_CHI_SEA.conditions: Mostly cloudy and cool, high near 55, slight chance of rain; evening temps low 50s
2026_08_CHI_SEA.notes: NWS Seattle (checked Oct 26 per Football Nation preview): Monday slight chance of rain, mostly cloudy, high near 55. Forecast window in that source ended before the 5:15pm PT kickoff, and 6 days out, so low confidence; Seattle early-Nov climatology is ~50F with ~50% chance of measurable rain, so rain chance could rise. No wind signal found.
